name: MADMAX
full_name: MAgnetized Disk and Mirror Axion eXperiment
summary: An experiment enhancing high-frequency axion conversion with multiple dielectric disks and a mirror; prototypes have produced physics results and must be distinguished from the final-scale instrument.
detection_principle: Radiation from dielectric interfaces adds coherently in a magnetic field; tuning disk separations enhances conversion power.

status.label: Multiphase project: completed experiments alongside further construction / design
status.evidence: Official May 2026 update: the cryogenic system reached approximately 4 K; subsequent assembly and transfer to CERN remained planned.

key_parameters.name: Data-taking
key_parameters.value: 14.5 days; two narrow intervals near 76.6 and 79.4 μeV

phases.name: CB100 / CB200 / open prototypes
phases.description: Prototype tests and dark-matter searches at CERN and in Germany.

phases.name: Subsequent cryogenic prototype
phases.description: Cryogenic-system acceptance completed in 2026; full detector assembly remains ongoing.

phases.name: Final MADMAX
phases.description: Large-scale QCD-axion search, not treated as already operating.

results.summary: The prototype found no axions, demonstrating the real search capability of a dielectric haloscope.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
